# stripe_metronome_credit_type (Resource)

A custom Metronome credit type. Import by ID. Destroy archives it; built-in currency credit types cannot be archived by this resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the custom pricing unit shown on invoices.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_currency` (Boolean)
